properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transport for the Solana JSON-RPC client: http.Client instances built in rpc/client.go (newHTTP/newHTTPWithTimeout, sites 161/169/183) and rpc/jsonrpc/jsonrpc.go:374, plus two test files constructing the same client. No explicit TLS configuration anywhere in the tree (no CipherSuites/CurvePreferences, no InsecureSkipVerify, no custom RootCAs — grep: zero hits), so Go 1.25.0 (go.mod) default crypto/tls applies: TLS 1.3 with X25519MLKEM768 hybrid key exchange offered by default — a PQ-capable peer

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: deriveKey (vault/kmsgcp.go:87) turns the user's vault passphrase + 16-byte random salt into a 32-byte key-encryption key: argon2.IDKey(passphrase, salt, time=4, memory=64 MiB, parallelism=4, keyLen=32) — Argon2id at RFC 9106-recommended interactive settings, exceeding OWASP minimums. Called from PassphraseBoxer.Seal/Open (vault/passphrase.go:50, :72) to encrypt the wallet key bag at rest (secretbox, filed separately). Argon2id is a memory-hard KDF, quantum-resistant; no PQ migration needed.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.value: Google Cloud KMS envelope encryption for the vault key bag (KMSGCPBoxer, wrap type "kms-gcp"): a fresh 32-byte DEK from crypto/rand is wrapped via the Cloud KMS Encrypt API on the CryptoKey resource named by keyPath (config-supplied), cached, and unwrapped via Decrypt on open (fetchPlainDEK).
